GLFW setWindowIcon / Service-Port Boot Crash Fix (macOS)
nodes.rationale: 1.13-1.18 unconditionally call glfwSetWindowIcon at boot (no OS guard until 1.19); LWJGL 3.3.x's GLFW 3.4-dev raises error 65548 which the boot error callback treats as fatal, while LWJGL 3.2.3's older GLFW hits a separate 'service port for display' error 65544 on modern macOS (Tahoe). Fix: swap in MinecraftMachina's patched lwjgl-glfw bindings jar (nglfwSetWindowIcon becomes a Java-level no-op) atop LWJGL 3.3.1, used for both arm64 and x64 override tables.

nodes.label: Instance List / Dropdown Scroll Virtualization
nodes.rationale: Full-list re-instantiation on every scroll/search keystroke caused lag: PNG icons loaded from disk on each render (fixed by embedding an Assets.logo fallback), InstanceCard virtualization added via an in-viewport flag with quantized integer row-index bounds, and create-dialog version dropdowns switched from ScrollView+for to Slint's built-in lazily-instantiated ListView.
